title: LeRobot 0.7 adds YAM, reBot B601 and Unitree G1 with SONIC support
summary: LeRobot 0.7 adds support for the I2RT YAM arm (one or two arms, gravity feed-forward from the arm model), the Seeed reBot B601 and the Unitree G1 with SONIC, with docs for each.

appearances.title: LeRobot 0.7 drives YAM, reBot B601, and Unitree G1
appearances.summary: LeRobot 0.7 can drive one or two YAM arms, with gravity feed-forward from the arm's own model, and the reBot B601 on RobStride or Damiao motors, including a mix of both in one bimanual setup. A Unitree G1 policy can emit a 64-D motion token that NVIDIA SONIC decodes to 50 Hz targets for all 29 joints, including remote inference, and the 23-DoF G1 uses the same driver.
